question: The Matrice 4T ASRS report proves it lost its link and crashed. What should it have done according to the manual?

intake.reason: Question asks what the manual directs the drone to do when control link is lost.

brief.short_answer: Per the Matrice 4T manual, loss of the remote signal triggers a failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH; the aircraft will automatically initiate RTH and continue it even if the RC link returns. RTH can also be started by the user or due to low battery, using Advanced RTH as configured. Under suitable lighting, the RTH path may be shown before loss.

claims.text: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Control inputs not synchronized or delayed Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.

claims.text: Ensure accurate control communications are established and reliable prior to further flight to circumvent possible loss of control resulting in the risk of a collision or flyaway.
claims.quote: Ensure accurate control communications are established and reliable prior to further flight to circumvent possible loss of control resulting in the risk of a collision or flyaway.

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action is set to RTH

claims.text: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).
claims.quote: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).

claims.text: If the lighting and environment conditions are suitable for the vision system, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost.
claims.quote: When the lighting and environment conditions are suitable for the vision system, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost.
conditions: Lighting and environment suitable for the vision system

claims.text: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.
claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
